prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE transparent 2D animation sprite sheet with EIGHT COMPLETE CHARACTER drawings in a precisely spaced 4 columns by 2 rows grid, read left to right across the top row, then left to right across the bottom row. Wide landscape canvas. Eight equal square cells, invisible borders, each character fully inside its own cell with 8% empty margins. No labels, panels, text captions, floor, shadows, background, motion streaks or duplicated body parts. Truly transparent alpha.
Image 1 is the identity/style reference: chibi blue gradient wavy hair, ahoge, blue-white whale ears and blue whale tail, orange asterisk hair clip, cream hoodie with caramel bow and orange sleeve asterisks, small flower patch on pocket, tan pleated skirt and white frill, white flower legwarmers, brown Mary Jane shoes. Preserve identity, head/body ratio, rendering style and camera across ALL EIGHT drawings. Badge says exactly "Claude" in black on white, orange rim; do not replace it with a flower. Each pose is a complete organically drawn body, two arms/hands and two legs only. No paper cutout articulation. Character's scale and horizontal center identical in every cell.  Supporting Image 2 is a eight-time-point contact sheet from the ORIGINAL dsh-pet video. Use it ONLY to understand the action poses, sequencing and interaction; do NOT copy its maid outfit, hairstyle proportions, labels, background or panel design. The replacement character must wear Image 1's cream hoodie, orange details and Claude badge. Leave MORE empty margin than the previous sheets: character occupies only central 75% of EACH cell, ahoge, hands, tail and shoes never touch cell edges.
Eight distinct chronological drawings, exact 4x2 invisible grid. Supporting reference has ONLY four video samples; draw eight intermediate whole-body poses for this new animation.
REMAKE RUN CYCLE. Image 2 shows accepted walking anatomy and opposite arm/leg phases, not an outfit change. New action is FAST RUN LEFT in true left profile. Exactly eight poses 4x2, ample 12% margins. All faces look LEFT. The FRONT/NEAR sleeve and near leg must clearly reverse between top row and bottom row. Frame1: NEAR leg forward reaching, NEAR ARM bent back behind waist, FAR ARM bent FORWARD near chin. Frame2: near foot plants underneath hip, near arm passes waist. Frame3: near leg pushes backward, far knee swings forward, NEAR ARM rises forward. Frame4: airborne, NEAR knee folds BACK behind body while FAR leg reaches left; NEAR ARM forward, FAR ARM backward. Frame5: FAR foot lands in front, NEAR leg behind, NEAR ARM FORWARD across chest, FAR ARM back. Frame6: far foot planted under hip, near knee swings forward, near arm passes waist going back. Frame7: far leg pushes back and NEAR knee forward, NEAR ARM back. Frame8 airborne NEAR leg reaches forward left, FAR knee folds behind, NEAR ARM BACK and FAR ARM FORWARD. Draw two bent arms and two distinct legs, no same-side arm/leg advancing together. Do NOT repeat top row as bottom row. Body scale/camera and hair consistent. Badge exactly Claude. No captions/gridlines/ground/glow.
